concept.hr: Wi-Fi izbjegava sudare koje ne može otkriti; RTS/CTS rješava skriveni čvor
concept.en: Wi-Fi avoids collisions it can't detect; RTS/CTS fixes the hidden node

summary.hr: Korak po korak: DIFS, slučajno čekanje koje stoji dok je medij zauzet, ACK i udvostručeni CW, NAV iz CTS-a i prag RTS_Threshold.
summary.en: Step by step: DIFS, a random backoff that freezes while the medium is busy, ACK and a doubled CW, NAV from the CTS, and RTS_Threshold.
